ai.headline: Temu revises its Terms of Use, including arbitration and payment wording
ai.summary: Temu's updated Terms of Use mostly reword or reformat existing text, with a few substantive additions: customs duties and taxes are now more explicitly your responsibility, title and risk of loss for products pass to you at a different point depending on whether the order is fulfilled inside or outside the US, and returned products stay in your title until they reach Temu's location. Several sections also now say that prices exclude taxes, duties, and shipping, and that you may need to pay App Store taxes.
